statement: The seven-node in-process cold-formation probe's cross-owner harness model is derived from the registered owner contracts rather than hand-maintained: a model module enumerates every registered coupled pair and contract as a driver-host that hosts the real production owner with its drive methods sealed, every registered invariant owner is a hosted owner, the hand-wired stand-in family in the membership-consistency helpers is replaced by those hosts, and a test derived from the registry fails whenever a registered interaction is absent from the model, so the model can no longer go stale without the gate saying so.

constraints.statement: The checklist is derived at test time from test/shards/impact-contracts.json and architecture/contracts/invariants.json; no interaction id is typed into the model or the test by hand.

A host inherits the production prototype and seals its drive methods against override, in the shape of test/convergence/membership-publication-owner-driver-host.js; a hand-built object implementing an owner's methods is a stand-in, not a host.
Nothing here memoises or caches readiness; the sealed bounded-read-amplification-scope constraint of the epic holds.
The seven-node probe's assertions and budgets are unchanged; it consumes the hosts, it does not weaken.
Any change under src/ lands only behind an independent verification (epic guardrail).
